description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveSpansWithoutAttributes that extends another injector class to remove <span> elements that have no attributes from HTML content during purification, including methods for handling elements and end tags, as well as preparing the injector.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveSpansWithoutAttributes
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_Injector to remove span elements without attributes during HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the injector, setting up a SplObjectStorage to mark deletion targets.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the injector with configuration and context objects, initializing an attribute validator.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles span elements; validates attributes and marks empty spans for deletion.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end tokens and deletes marked tokens.
